translation.en: There is much work today.
The man finished the work.
The father returned from work.
The result of the work is good.
The neighbors' son is reading a book.
The man visited the neighbors' son.

translation.bs: Dijete se igralo sa sinom komšija.
translation.en: The child played with the neighbors' son.
The neighbors' son's house is near.
The blessing is great.

translation.bs: Čovjek je bio zahvalan na blagodati.
translation.en: The man was thankful for the blessing.
The children were glad of the blessing.
Gratitude for a blessing is a duty.
The light is strong.
The child turned off the light.
The cat sat in the light.
The color of the light is yellow.
The account is correct.

translation.bs: Čovjek je otvorio račun u banci.
translation.en: The man opened an account at the bank.

translation.bs: Knjigovođa je našao grešku u računu.
translation.en: The accountant found a mistake in the account.
The account number is long.
The misdeed is heavy.
The man left his misdeeds behind.
The child admitted the misdeed.
The trace of the misdeed is clear.
The goods are heavy.
The traveler carried the goods.

translation.bs: Čuvar je našao nož u robi.
translation.en: The guard found a knife in the goods.
The owner of the goods is absent.
The team won.
The coach trained the team.
The child played with the team.
The team's captain is brave.
The thief's plot failed.
The police officer discovered the plot.
The merchant escaped the plot.
The goal of the plot is clear.
Grandfather's hearing is weak.
The doctor examined the hearing.
The doctor spoke about hearing.
Weak hearing is widespread.
Punishment is sometimes necessary.
The judge mitigated the punishment.
The thief escaped punishment.
The type of punishment is light.
Kinship is a strong tie.
The sons respected kinship.
The family is proud of kinship.
The connection of kinship is important.
The grandfather's back is weak.
The child washed the horse's back.

translation.bs: Dijete je sjelo na devina leđa.
translation.en: The child sat on the camel's back.
Back pain is tiring.
The teacher's standing is great.

translation.bs: Student je znao mjesto svog profesora.
translation.en: The student knew his professor's standing.

translation.bs: Gost je sjeo na visoko mjesto.
translation.en: The guest sat in a high place.
The man of high standing is humble.
The stick broke.
The farmer carried the staff.
Grandfather walked with the stick.
The length of the stick is a metre.
Commerce is lucrative.
The young man learned commerce.
The man worked in commerce.
The profit of the commerce is little.
The fruit matured in the garden.
The farmer gathered the fruit.
The farmer was glad about the fruit of the tree.
The taste of the fruit is sweet.
The journey is pleasing.
The students loved the journey.
The father returned from the journey.
The time of the journey is short.
The year passed quickly.
The students began the new year.

translation.bs: Porodica putuje dva puta u godini.
translation.en: The family travels two times a year.
The beginning of the year is near.
The rain fell yesterday.
The farmer waited for the rain.

translation.bs: Djeca su se igrala na kiši.
translation.en: The children played in the rain.
The sound of the rain is beautiful.
The dreams were beautiful.
The child remembered the dreams.
The father spoke about the dreams.
The explanation of dreams is difficult.

translation.bs: Bijes se pojavio na njegovom licu.
translation.en: The anger appeared on his face.
The news provoked anger.

translation.bs: Lice djeteta je pocrvenjelo od bijesa.
translation.en: The child's face turned red from anger.
The intensity of anger is harmful.
The shirt is clean.
The mother washed the shirt.
A stain appeared on the shirt.
The color of the shirt is blue.
Old age weakens the body.
Grandfather accepted old age.
Grandfather rests in old age.
The illnesses of old age are many.
The appointment approached.
The patient forgot the appointment.
The friend was late for the appointment.
The time of the appointment is suitable.
The bracelets are beautiful.
The girl put on the bracelets.
The grandmother was happy with the bracelets.
The sound of the bracelets is beautiful.
The horses run in the field.
The farmer feeds the horses.
The merchants traveled with the horses.
The horses' stable is clean.
The prisoner returned to his family.
The soldiers released the prisoners.
The family sent a letter to the prisoner.
The prisoner's mother rejoiced.
Falsehood harms society.
The judge rejected the falsehood.
The witness kept away from falsehood.
False testimony is a crime.
The knot is strong.
The sailor ties the knot.
The child looked at the knots.
The form of the knot is beautiful.
The consequence of laziness was large.
The student knew the consequence of laziness.

translation.bs: Učitelj je upozorio na posljedicu laži.
translation.en: The teacher warned of the consequence of lying.
The cause of the bad consequence is laziness.
The maternal aunt visited my grandmother.
The children loved the maternal aunt.
The girl traveled with the maternal aunt.
The maternal aunt's house is near.
Gambling is a bad habit.
The young man rejected gambling.

translation.bs: Otac je upozorio svog sina na kocku.
translation.en: The father warned his son of gambling.
The young man knew the danger of gambling.
A long age passed.
The poet described the age.

translation.bs: Historičar je pisao o drevnom dobu.
translation.en: The historian wrote about the ancient age.
The events of the age are many.
The smoke rises above the houses.
The neighbors smelled the smoke.
The child coughed from the smoke.
The odor of the smoke is strong.
The student's justification is accepted.
The worker offered a justification to the manager.
The teacher asked about the justification.
The strength of the justification convinced the judge.
The witness's oath convinced the judge.
The students repeated the oath.
The man fulfilled the oath.
The sincerity of the oath is important.
The abundance of voices bothered the child.
The visitors noticed the abundance of trees.
The teacher was happy about the abundance of students.
The reason for the abundance of flowers is the rain.
